rationale: The app binds the customer's existing Documents TABLE and maps its columns at placement time. PDF values remain row-owned Wallboard filePicker references rather than a separate File System binding.
acceptedValueShapes: native datasource object containing the Documents table
selected Documents table object containing rows
JSON string of any documented shape

behavior.unbound: render synthetic representative documents in local preview only
behavior.boundEmpty: render the configured empty state without substituting sample records
behavior.invalidRows: retain readable rows with missing PDF values and disable their document-open action
behavior.fieldMapping: read title, PDF, category, up to six optional metadata values, and an optional scheduling-type column from configured column names
behavior.assetLookup: preserve each PDF filePicker id, name, and location and cache the selected location through the platform before rendering
behavior.filtering: derive category buttons from schedule-eligible rows, retain unscheduled rows, hide rows before their local schedule start or after their end plus configured retention days, and search title, category, PDF name, and mapped metadata
